sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fixed a column swap on 'label-relationships'/'place-performances' pages: after clicking a sub-section's "Show single-table" button (or a Load-from-Disk round trip), the "Release events" column showed the "Relationships" column's data and vice versa. Caused by initReleaseEventsColumn()'s _ensureReCell() blindly appending the recreated Release events placeholder cell after the already-restored Relationships cell instead of inserting it before, one column out of step with the fixed header order.
